# FQHELatticeBosonsCorrelation

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnLattice` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnLattice/FQHELatticeBosonsCorrelation`

```text
FQHELatticeBosonsCorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: FQHELatticeBosonsCorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --states : filenames of state vectors to be processed (multiple arguments)
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 0)
    -x, --lx : length in x-direction of given lattice (default value = 0)
    -y, --ly : length in y-direction of given lattice (default value = 0)
    -q, --flux : number of flux quanta piercing the lattice (default value = 0)
    -r, --reference : reference site for two-particle correlations (default value = 0)
    -c, --hard-core : Use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons
    -n, --no-hard-core : Do not use Hilbert-space of hard-core bosons (overriding detection from filename)
    --density : plot density insted of density-density correlation
    --fluctuations : plot local density fluctuations
    --all-ops : plot all available operators

lattice options:
    -L, --lattice-definition : File defining the geometry of the lattice
    -C, --cells-repeat : number of times unit cell is repeated in the x-, y-,..., dim- directions of the lattice (overriding default given in definition)
    --normalize-lattice : normalize unit cell area to #of sites, and field strength to one
    --external-parameters : values of external parameters for lattice definition

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -g, --gnuplot : format output for gnuplot, and make plot
    -h, --help : display this help

precalculation options:
    --fast-search : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast state search (in Mbytes) (default value = 9)

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
